reason: The price is nothing for my firm and the evening paperwork is killing me, but I will not put 40 technicians and all my customer and AMC data on an app from a company I have never heard of. If it shuts down in six months I have retrained everyone for nothing and my records are stuck somewhere.
objection: Who is behind this and will it still be around next year? Also, will my older technicians actually press the button after every job, or will I still be phoning them all day?
would_change_my_mind: Two or three Chennai service companies of my size that have used it for months and that I can call myself, plus a written promise that I can export all my job and AMC data if I leave.
